2607.06008.title: PolyWorkBench: Benchmarking Multilingual Long-Horizon LLM Agents
2607.06008.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown strong performance in long-horizon tasks that require planning, tool use, and interaction with external environments. However, most existing benchmarks implicitly assume a monolingual setting, where the entire execution process, including reasoning, tool invocation, and output generation, is conducted within a single language. In contrast, real-world applications often involve multilingual inputs and outputs within a unified workflow, yet the interaction between multilinguality and agentic execution remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce PolyWorkBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on multilingual long-horizon workplace workflows. PolyWorkBench consists of 67 tasks across five domains, including commerce, knowledge work, legal analysis, localization, and manufacturing, where agents must process heterogeneous multilingual inputs, perform iterative reasoning, invoke external tools, and produce structured outputs. To enable comprehensive evaluation, we propose a hybrid framework that combines structural grading, executable verification, and LLM-based semantic assessment. This design allows us to capture both functional correctness and linguistic consistency across complex workflows. Empirical results show that state-of-the-art LLM agents suffer significant performance degradation in multilingual workflow settings compared to monolingual counterparts. Our analysis suggests that multilinguality introduces compounding effects across reasoning and execution steps, highlighting the importance of jointly modeling language variation and procedural decision-making in agent evaluation.
2607.06008.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理在需要規劃、工具使用和與外部環境互動的長期任務中表現出色。<lb/>然而，大多數現有基準隱含地假設單語言環境，其中整個執行過程，包括推理、工具調用和輸出生成，都是在單一語言中進行的。<lb/>相對而言，現實世界的應用通常涉及統一工作流程中的多語言輸入和輸出，但多語言性與代理執行之間的互動仍然未被充分探索。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們介紹了 PolyWorkBench，一個用於評估 LLM 代理在多語言長期工作流程中的基準。<lb/>PolyWorkBench 包含來自五個領域的 67 個任務，包括商業、知識工作、法律分析、本地化和製造，代理必須處理異質的多語言輸入、執行迭代推理、調用外部工具並生成結構化輸出。<lb/>為了實現全面評估，我們提出了一個混合框架，結合結構評分、可執行驗證和基於 LLM 的語義評估。<lb/>這一設計使我們能夠捕捉到複雜工作流程中的功能正確性和語言一致性。<lb/>實證結果顯示，與單語對應者相比，最先進的 LLM 代理在多語言工作流程環境中遭遇了顯著的性能下降。<lb/>我們的分析表明，多語言性在推理和執行步驟中引入了累積效應，突顯了在代理評估中共同建模語言變化和程序決策的重要性。
